description: Orca lets you run a fleet of coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

latest_release.name: v1.4.253
latest_release.body:
## A little update ✨

We released two updates today! Check out the [v1.4.252 release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.252) for chat forking and Plan mode, a smoother phone experience, and workspace organization across machines.

A small release with a few minor improvements. A bigger one is coming later 🫣

## What's changed

* Reduce repeated work during host-status updates by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/39340
* Reduce process launches when reading Linux process start times by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/39439
* Dim the chat message rail until hover, focus or scroll by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/39369

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stablyai/orca/compare/v1.4.252...v1.4.253

Mobile pairing via Relay fails: relay_control_not_active
[bug] Windows: marketplace upgrade staging directories are not cleaned up and can grow to multiple GB

discussions.title: Supported no-force worktree removal after verified local preservation (Orca 1.4.224)
Supported per-session isolated Codex home for local-only capture (Orca 1.4.224)
Contributor experience: startup cost when iterating on tests
I'd like to contribute a fix that wraps the Japanese IME preedit at the right edge

detail.readme_excerpt:
Orca

中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español · Français · Português · Türkçe · Русский

The AI Orchestrator for 100x builders.
Run Claude Code, Codex, and any other coding agent in parallel, each in its own worktree. Chat or terminal, on your laptop or in the cloud, with diffs, a browser, and a CLI in one app.

Download Orca

## Features
### Orchestrate Agents Hand a big task to one agent. It splits the work, starts worker agents in their own workspaces, and brings their results back to you. [Docs →](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/cli/orchestration)
### Chat or Terminal Run any agent in Chat UI or as the raw CLI, and move a conversation between the two without losing context. [Docs →](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/agents/native-chat)
